blocks.text: Get more with Google Pixel 10a.[1] It has brilliant photography, helpful AI, and a durable design.[3] It’s more than you’d expect, for less.

items: Google Pixel 10a is a durable, everyday phone with more[1]; snap brilliant photography on a simple, powerful camera, get 30+ hours out of a full charge[2], and do more with helpful AI like Gemini[3]
Unlocked Android phone gives you the flexibility to change carriers and choose your own data plan; it works with Google Fi, Verizon, T-Mobile, AT&T, and other major carriers
Pixel 10a is sleek and durable, with a super smooth finish, scratch-resistant Corning Gorilla Glass 7i display, and IP68 water and dust protection[4]
The Actua display with 3,000-nit peak brightness shows up clear as day, even in direct sunlight[5]

Plan, create, and get more done with help from Gemini, your built-in AI assistant[3]; have it screen spam calls while you focus[6]; chat with Gemini to brainstorm your meal plan[7], or bring your ideas to life with Nano Banana[8]

items.label: Compatible Devices
items.value: Android Compatible Bluetooth Devices, Fitbit Fitness Trackers, Google Pixel Buds, Google Pixel Smart Watch, Google Pixel Tablets

items.label: Additional Features
items.value: Dual SIM (Single Nano SIM and eSIM), Fast Charging Support, Gemini AI Assistant, IP68 Dust & Water Resistant, Wireless charging (Qi-certified)

items.label: Rear Facing Camera Photo Sensor Resolution
Frame Rate
items.value: Front Camera: 4K at 30 FPS, Rear Camera: 1080p at 30/60 FP, Rear Camera: 4K at 30/60 FPS

items.label: Connectivity Technology
items.value: 5G + Wifi 6e + Bluetooth v6, Bluetooth, NFC, USB, Wi-Fi

items.label: Built-in Media
items.value: 1m USB-C cable (USB 2.0), Pixel 10a 256G Obsidian, Quick Start Guide, SIM Tray Ejector
